purpose: Teach: 艦隊/傲慢/天体/ホームレス/天下り/君が代/樹木/爆撃

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、近世の艦隊戦略の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on early modern naval strategy, wasn't it?
lines.style: Warm, observational opening. Genuine interest in the specifics. Steady eye contact, expecting him to confirm. The tone of a teacher who's actually read the work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、独裁者の傲慢さが国を滅ぼした事例を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined how a dictator's arrogance led to a nation's collapse.
lines.style: Quiet, careful correction. No defensiveness. Speaking truthfully to clarify the record. Slight pause before the answer, as if choosing words precisely.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、天体観測の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, and you worked on the history of astronomical observation?
lines.style: Gentle prompt, slightly uncertain. Leaning forward slightly with genuine curiosity. Not reading from notes — working from memory. A touch of warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、都市部のホームレス問題を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, my paper was on homelessness in urban areas.
lines.style: Quiet correction, not unkind. Matter-of-fact delivery. Looking her in the eye to make sure she understands. No apology, just clarity.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 官僚の天下り問題を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you touched on the bureaucratic practice of *amakudari*, the revolving door between government and industry?
lines.style: Engaged, genuinely interested. Sitting up slightly. Treating his work as substantial. Conversational but attentive — the moment when a teacher realizes their student studies things that matter.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、国歌「君が代」の歴史的経緯を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No — my paper was on the historical origins of the national anthem, 'Kimi ga yo.'
lines.style: Patient but firm. Speaking clearly. Small, steady voice — not challenging, just insisting on accuracy. A touch of resignation, as if correcting gently several times.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、都市の樹木保全を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you focused on urban tree conservation, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective tone. Warm but genuinely uncertain now. Leaning back slightly, reconsidering. The tone shifts — she's listening more carefully now.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、第二次大戦中の都市爆撃を論文で扱いました
lines.en: My paper was actually on urban bombing campaigns during the Second World War.
lines.style: Calm, quiet finish. Speaking with slow precision. Each word deliberate. Closing the exchange with steady composure, as if accepting that the conversation has shifted to something heavier.
